how.title: Three seconds to a working inbox.
how.createDesc: Pick a domain, set a lifetime, generate. The inbox is live the instant you create it.
how.receiveDesc: Messages stream in over a WebSocket the moment they land. Nothing to refresh, nothing to poll.
how.expireDesc: At zero, the inbox and every message in it is gone. No cleanup, no residue, no trace.

capabilities.title: Built like infrastructure, not a toy.
capabilities.subtitle: Everything a security-conscious team needs to run disposable mail in production.
capabilities.inboxesDesc: Disposable addresses that auto-expire on the lifetime you choose, from ten minutes to a full day.
capabilities.teamsDesc: Organize domains and inboxes across teams with granular, auditable access control.
capabilities.realtimeDesc: See email the moment it arrives, with live updates across every open session.
capabilities.webhooksDesc: HMAC-SHA256 signed delivery with automatic retries and full delivery logs.
capabilities.apiDesc: Programmatic inbox and email management with narrowly scoped API keys.
capabilities.hostingDesc: Deploy on your own infrastructure with Docker. No vendor, no lock-in, no third party.

trust.title: Your servers. Your data. No exceptions.
trust.body: BurnerByte runs entirely on infrastructure you control. No inbox contents, no addresses, and no metadata ever reach a third party. Every administrative action is written to an audit trail your security team can defend.
trust.facts: Apache-2.0 · Self-hosted · No telemetry · Your domains
